# 1. Batch overview {.tabset}

## Verdict table (with scrolling)

```{r triage-table}
triage_tbl %>%
  arrange(seqName) %>%
  transmute(
    `LabWareID`     = if_else(!is.na(LabWareID), LabWareID, "â€”"),
    `SequenceID`    = if_else(!is.na(SekvensID), SekvensID, "â€”"),
    `Genotype (NC)` = if_else(!is.na(clade), clade, "â€”"),
    `Genotype (BLAST)` = if_else(!is.na(blast_genotype), blast_genotype, "â€”"),
    `BLAST top hit` = if_else(!is.na(sseqid), sseqid, "â€”"),
    `BLAST variant` = if_else(!is.na(blast_variant), blast_variant, "â€”"),
    `BLAST SNPs`    = if_else(!is.na(blast_mismatch), as.character(blast_mismatch), "â€”"),
    `DB variant count` = if_else(!is.na(db_variant_count), as.character(db_variant_count), "â€”"),
    `Similar BLAST variant` = if_else(similar_variants_msg != "", similar_variants_msg, "â€”"),
    `Input length`  = if_else(!is.na(input_length), as.character(input_length), "â€”"),
    `Ambiguous`     = if_else(!is.na(ambiguous_count), as.character(ambiguous_count), "â€”"),
    .clade = clade,
    .blast_genotype = blast_genotype,
    .clade_agree_blast = clade_agree_blast
  ) -> .triage_display

# Calculate background colors for BLAST SNPs column
.snp_colors <- .triage_display$`BLAST SNPs` %>%
  map_chr(~ {
    if (. == "â€”") {
      ""  # Empty string for no background
    } else {
      snp_count <- as.numeric(.)
      if (snp_count == 0) {
        "#c8e6c9"  # Light green for 0 SNPs
      } else if (snp_count <= 2) {
        "#fff9c4"  # Light yellow for 1-2 SNPs
      } else {
        ""  # Empty string for no background
      }
    }
  })

# Calculate background colors for Input length column (yellow if != 460)
.input_length_colors <- .triage_display$`Input length` %>%
  map_chr(~ {
    if (. == "â€”") {
      ""
    } else {
      length_val <- as.numeric(.)
      if (!is.na(length_val) && length_val != 460) {
        "rgb(230, 218, 111)"  # Light yellow for non-460 lengths
      } else {
        ""
      }
    }
  })

# Calculate background colors for Genotype (NC) and Genotype (BLAST) if they don't match
.genotype_nc_colors <- map2_chr(.triage_display$.clade, .triage_display$.clade_agree_blast, ~ {
  if (!is.na(.y) && !.y) {
    "#ffcccb"  # Light red for disagreement
  } else {
    ""
  }
})

.genotype_blast_colors <- map2_chr(.triage_display$.blast_genotype, .triage_display$.clade_agree_blast, ~ {
  if (!is.na(.y) && !.y) {
    "#ffcccb"  # Light red for disagreement
  } else {
    ""
  }
})

.triage_display %>%
  select(-starts_with(".")) %>%
  kbl(escape = FALSE,
      table.attr = 'style="width: auto;"',
      caption = "Batch overview â€” sorted by sequence name. Red background on Genotype columns indicates disagreement between NextClade (NC) and BLAST genotype assignments. DB variant count = number of sequences in reference database with same BLAST variant.") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "10em", extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%  # LabWareID
  column_spec(2, width = "12em", extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%  # SequenceID
  column_spec(3, width = "10em", background = .genotype_nc_colors, extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%  # Genotype (NC)
  column_spec(4, width = "12em", background = .genotype_blast_colors, extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%  # Genotype (BLAST)
  column_spec(5, width = "14em", extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%  # BLAST top hit
  column_spec(6, width = "16em", extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%  # BLAST variant
  column_spec(7, background = .snp_colors, bold = TRUE) %>%  # Color code BLAST SNPs
  column_spec(9, width = "20em", extra_css = "min-width: 18em; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.2; word-break: break-word;") %>%  # Similar BLAST variant
  column_spec(10, background = .input_length_colors) %>%  # Color code Input length
  scroll_box(width = "100%")
```

## Placement tree (NextClade)

```{r placement-tree, results='asis'}
.nwk_path <- file.path(out_dir, "lineages", "nextclade.nwk")
.ptr <- if (file.exists(.nwk_path)) tryCatch(read.tree(.nwk_path), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL

if (is.null(.ptr)) {
  cat("NextClade placement tree (`nextclade.nwk`) not found â€” run the NextClade step first.")
} else {
  .qids <- word(all_queries, 1)
  .tipmeta <- tibble(label = .ptr$tip.label) %>%
    left_join(community_meta %>% transmute(label = id, ref_clade = community_clade), by = "label") %>%
    left_join(triage_tbl %>% transmute(label = word(seqName, 1), q_clade = clade), by = "label") %>%
    mutate(
      is_query = label %in% .qids,
      Genotype = coalesce(q_clade, ref_clade),
      Genotype = if_else(is.na(Genotype) | Genotype %in% c("", "NA"), "unassigned", str_to_upper(Genotype))
    )

  .gtypes <- sort(setdiff(unique(.tipmeta$Genotype), "unassigned"))
  .pal <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(.gtypes)), .gtypes)
  .pal["unassigned"] <- "grey80"

  p_place <- ggtree(.ptr, layout = "fan", open.angle = 12, size = 0.15, color = "grey55") %<+% .tipmeta +
    geom_tippoint(aes(color = Genotype, size = is_query, alpha = is_query)) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.5, `TRUE` = 3.2), guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.55, `TRUE` = 1), guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = .pal, name = "Genotype / clade",
                       breaks = .gtypes) +
    ggtree::geom_tiplab2(aes(label = ifelse(is_query, label, NA), color = Genotype),
                         size = 3, fontface = "bold", offset = 0.001, na.rm = TRUE) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
    labs(title = "Batch samples placed on the NextClade reference tree",
         subtitle = sprintf("%d reference tips + %d batch samples (bold red-rim labels). Placement uses the VP1-2B junction.",
                            sum(!.tipmeta$is_query), sum(.tipmeta$is_query))) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

  placement_tree_png <- file.path(
    report_figures_dir,
    "placement_phylogenetic_tree.png"
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = placement_tree_png,
    plot = p_place,
    width = 11,
    height = 11,
    dpi = 180,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  if (!file.exists(placement_tree_png)) {
    stop(
      "Placement tree figure was not created: ",
      placement_tree_png
    )
  }

  .embed_tree(
    placement_tree_png,
    alt = "NextClade placement phylogenetic tree"
  )
}
```

```{r batch-qc, results='asis'}
# Get batch sample names (first token, trimmed)
batch_sample_names <- word(query_ids_normalized, 1)
batch_seqs_in_alignment <- batch_sample_names[batch_sample_names %in% query_ids_normalized]

  batch_aln_file_aligned <- file.path(trees_dir, "batch", "batch.aligned.fasta")
  batch_tree_available <- file.exists(batch_tree_file) && file.info(batch_tree_file)$size > 0
  batch_aln_available <- file.exists(batch_aln_file_aligned) && file.info(batch_aln_file_aligned)$size > 0
  
  # If batch files missing, try to run build_batch_analysis.sh

      batch_aln_available <- file.exists(batch_aln_file_aligned) && file.info(batch_aln_file_aligned)$size > 0
    } # end auto-generate batch analysis
  } # end batch file availability check
  cat("## Batch phylogenetic tree\n\n")
  
  batch_tree_obj <- NULL
  if (batch_tree_available) {
    batch_tree_obj <- tryCatch(read.tree(batch_tree_file), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  
  if (is.null(batch_tree_obj)) {
    # Tree not available - provide instructions
    cat("*Batch phylogenetic tree not available.*\n\n")
    cat("**To generate batch-specific phylogenetic tree and SNP matrix, run:**\n\n")
    cat("```bash\n")
    cat("bash scripts/build_batch_analysis.sh ")
    cat(sprintf("'%s' '%s' '%s'\n", params$batch_dir, params$dataset_date, params$out_base))
    cat("```\n\n")

    cat("1. Extract batch sequences from per-sequence analyses\n")
    cat("2. Align sequences with MAFFT\n")
    cat("3. Infer phylogenetic tree with IQ-TREE\n")
    cat("4. Compute SNP distance matrix\n\n")
    cat("After running, re-generate this report to include batch phylogenetics.\n\n")
  }  else {
  # end batch tree availability check 
    # We have the batch tree - visualize it
    batch_tree_obj <- phangorn::midpoint(batch_tree_obj)
    
    # Metadata for batch tips

    batch_tree_png <- file.path(

)

ggsave(
  filename = batch_tree_png,
  plot = p_batch,
  width = 14,

if (!file.exists(batch_tree_png)) {

    "Batch phylogenetic tree for",

)
  } # end batch tree visualization
  
  cat("## Batch SNP distance heatmap\n\n")
  
  batch_snp_file <- file.path(params$out_base, "snp_matrices", "batch_snp_distances.tsv")
  batch_snp_mat <- NULL
  
  # Option 1: Use pre-computed SNP matrix from build_batch_analysis.sh
  if (file.exists(batch_snp_file)) {
    batch_snp_mat <- tryCatch({
      mat <- read.delim(batch_snp_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
      as.matrix(mat)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  
  # Option 2: Build from per-sequence blast-only alignments (fallback)
  if (is.null(batch_snp_mat)) {
    batch_seqs_data <- tibble()
    
    for (seq_id in batch_seqs_in_alignment) {
      seq_aln_file <- file.path(trees_dir, seq_id, "aligned_trimmed_blast_only.fa")
      if (file.exists(seq_aln_file)) {
        tryCatch({
          aln <- ape::read.dna(seq_aln_file, format = "fasta", as.character = TRUE)
          if (nrow(aln) > 0) {
            # Get first row (query sequence)
            query_seq <- aln[1, , drop = FALSE]
            rownames(query_seq) <- seq_id
            batch_seqs_data <- rbind(batch_seqs_data, as_tibble(query_seq, rownames = "id"))
          }
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
      }
    }
    
    # Compute SNP distance matrix if we have sequences
    if (nrow(batch_seqs_data) >= 2) {
      batch_seqs_mat <- as.matrix(batch_seqs_data %>% select(-id))
      rownames(batch_seqs_mat) <- batch_seqs_data$id
      
      n_batch <- nrow(batch_seqs_mat)
      batch_snp_mat <- matrix(0L, n_batch, n_batch, dimnames = list(rownames(batch_seqs_mat), rownames(batch_seqs_mat)))
      
      for (i in seq_len(n_batch - 1)) {
        for (j in (i + 1):n_batch) {
          s1 <- batch_seqs_mat[i, ]
          s2 <- batch_seqs_mat[j, ]
          valid <- (
  !is.na(s1) &
  !is.na(s2) &
  s1 != "-" &
  s2 != "-"
)

d <- sum(s1[valid] != s2[valid])
          batch_snp_mat[i, j] <- batch_snp_mat[j, i] <- d
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Display SNP heatmap if we have matrix
  if (!is.null(batch_snp_mat)) {
    # Defensive: duplicate sequence names would otherwise crash data.frame()
    # with "duplicate row.names" further down.
    if (anyDuplicated(rownames(batch_snp_mat)) > 0) {
      rownames(batch_snp_mat) <- make.unique(rownames(batch_snp_mat))
      colnames(batch_snp_mat) <- make.unique(colnames(batch_snp_mat))
    }
    batch_lbl <- rownames(batch_snp_mat)
    batch_ann_row <- data.frame(
      Type = rep("Batch", nrow(batch_snp_mat)),
      row.names = batch_lbl
    )
    batch_ann_colors <- list(Type = c(Batch = "#aec7e8"))
    
  # Prepare a robust colour scale for the batch SNP matrix
batch_colors <- colorRampPalette(
  c(
    "#f7fbff",
    "#deebf7",
    "#9ecae1",
    "#3182bd",
    "#08519c",
    "#08306b"
  )
)(100)

batch_values <- as.numeric(batch_snp_mat)
batch_values <- batch_values[is.finite(batch_values)]

if (length(batch_values) == 0) {
  cat("*Batch SNP matrix contains no finite values and cannot be plotted.*\n\n")
} else {
  batch_min <- min(batch_values)
  batch_max <- max(batch_values)
  batch_constant <- batch_min == batch_max

  if (batch_constant) {
    # A constant matrix, commonly all zeros, needs an artificial interval
    # because pheatmap requires strictly increasing break values.
    batch_breaks <- seq(
      from = batch_min - 0.5,
      to = batch_max + 0.5,
      length.out = length(batch_colors) + 1
    )

    batch_cluster_rows <- FALSE
    batch_cluster_cols <- FALSE
    batch_treeheight_row <- 0
    batch_treeheight_col <- 0
  } else {
    batch_breaks <- seq(
      from = batch_min,
      to = batch_max,
      length.out = length(batch_colors) + 1
    )

    batch_cluster_rows <- TRUE
    batch_cluster_cols <- TRUE
    batch_treeheight_row <- 50
    batch_treeheight_col <- 50
  }

  # Final defensive validation
  batch_breaks <- sort(unique(batch_breaks))

  if (length(batch_breaks) < 2) {
    batch_breaks <- c(batch_min - 0.5, batch_max + 0.5)
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(batch_breaks) > 0) {
    stop("Internal error: batch heatmap breaks are not unique")
  }

  batch_heatmap_png <- file.path(
  report_figures_dir,
  "batch_snp_heatmap.png"
)

.pb_obj <- pheatmap(
  batch_snp_mat,
  color = batch_colors,
  breaks = batch_breaks,
  cluster_rows = batch_cluster_rows,
  cluster_cols = batch_cluster_cols,
  clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(batch_snp_mat),
  clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(batch_snp_mat),
  clustering_method = "average",
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%d",
  number_color = "black",
  fontsize = 14,
  fontsize_number = 12,
  annotation_row = batch_ann_row,
  annotation_colors = batch_ann_colors,
  legend = !batch_constant,
  treeheight_row = batch_treeheight_row,
  treeheight_col = batch_treeheight_col,
  main = sprintf(
    "Batch %s - SNP distances",
    batch_name
  ),
  silent = TRUE
)

ggsave(
  filename = batch_heatmap_png,
  plot = .pb_obj$gtable,
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 150
)

if (!file.exists(batch_heatmap_png)) {
  stop("Batch SNP heatmap was not created: ", batch_heatmap_png)
}

.embed_img(
  batch_heatmap_png,
  alt = paste(
    "Batch SNP distance heatmap for",
    batch_name
  )
)


  if (batch_constant) {
    cat(
      sprintf(
        paste0(
          "*All pairwise batch SNP distances are %s. ",
          "Clustering was disabled because the distance matrix is constant.*\n\n"
        ),
        batch_min
      )
    )
  }
}  
  } else {
  # end batch SNP heatmap display
    cat("*Batch SNP distance matrix could not be computed. Run the batch analysis script to generate:*\n\n")
    cat("```bash\n")
    cat("bash scripts/build_batch_analysis.sh ")
    cat(sprintf("'%s' '%s' '%s'\n", params$batch_dir, params$dataset_date, params$out_base))
    cat("```\n\n")
  } # end batch SNP fallback
} # end batch size check

# 3. Variant naming

```{r variant-naming, results='asis'}
# Extract year from dataset_date parameter (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
dataset_year <- as.numeric(substr(params$dataset_date, 1, 4))
# Year for variant naming (might change at new year)
variant_year <- as.numeric(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))

# Check latest variant in database by NOR-YYYY pattern
if (nrow(meta) > 0 && "variant" %in% names(meta)) {
  db_variant <- meta %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(variant), 
      variant !="",
      grepl("^NOR-", variant)
      ) %>%
    pull(variant) %>%
    unique()
  
  current_year_variant <- db_variant[grepl(paste0("^NOR-", variant_year), db_variant)]
  if (length(current_year_variant) > 0) {
    # Extract version numbers (V1, V2, etc.) and sort numerically
    # Pattern: NOR-YYYY-VNN[a-z]? â†’ extract NN part
    base_versions <- as.numeric(gsub("^NOR-[0-9]+-V([0-9]+).*", "\\1", current_year_variant))
    latest_v <- max(base_versions, na.rm = TRUE)
    next_v <- latest_v + 1
  } else {
    latest_v <- 0
    next_v <- 1
  }
  
  # Show recent variants grouped by base version with b/c suffixes
  # Sort by year descending, then version number numerically
  cat("**Recent variants in database:**\n\n")
  
  # Parse variants to extract base version and suffix
  variant_parsed <- tibble(variant = unique(db_variant)) %>%
    filter(grepl("^NOR-", variant)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Extract year from variant (NOR-YYYY-Vx â†’ YYYY)
      year = as.numeric(str_extract(variant, "NOR-([0-9]+)", group = 1)),
      # Extract version full (V1, V1b, etc.)
      version_full = str_extract(variant, "V[0-9]+[a-z]*"),
      # Extract base version number
      base_v = as.numeric(str_extract(version_full, "[0-9]+"))
    ) %>%
    distinct(year, base_v, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # Keep only unique year+base_v combinations
    arrange(desc(year), desc(base_v)) %>%
    head(10) %>%  # Get top 10 most recent base versions
    arrange(year, base_v)  # Sort for display: oldest to newest
  
  # Group and display by year, then by base version (oldest to newest for display)
  for (yr in unique(sort(variant_parsed$year))) {
    year_data <- variant_parsed %>% filter(year == yr)
    cat("**NOR-", yr, ":**", sep = "")
    # Collect all variants for each base_v and display on same line
    variants_by_base <- list()
    for (bv in unique(sort(year_data$base_v))) {
      variants <- year_data %>%
        filter(base_v == bv) %>%
        pull(variant) %>%
        sort()
      variants_by_base[[as.character(bv)]] <- variants
    }
    # Display: V1 [V1b] format or V1 [no variants]
    display_str <- paste(sapply(names(variants_by_base), function(v) {
      base <- paste0("NOR-", yr, "-V", v)
      all_vars <- variants_by_base[[v]]
      suffixed <- all_vars[grepl("[a-z]$", all_vars)]
      if (length(suffixed) > 0) {
        paste0(base, " [", paste(sub(base, "", suffixed), collapse = ", "), "]")
      } else {
        base
      }
    }), collapse = ", ")
    cat(" ", display_str, "\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  cat(sprintf("**Latest NOR-%d variant: V%d, next candidate: V%d**\n\n", variant_year, latest_v, next_v))
} else {
  cat("*Unable to determine variant naming scheme â€” no variant data in reference database.*\n\n")
}

# Build variant suggestions table with smart b/c suffix suggestion
if (nrow(summary_tbl) > 0 && nrow(meta) > 0 && "variant" %in% names(meta)) {
  # Function to suggest next available suffix (b, c, d, etc.)
  suggest_suffix <- function(base_variant, existing_variants) {
    # Get all variants of this variant in the database
    variants <- existing_variants[grepl(paste0("^", base_variant, "[a-z]?$"), existing_variants)]
    
    if (length(variants) == 0) {
      # No variant exists, suggest 'b'
      return("b")
    }
    
    # Extract which suffixes exist
    suffixes <- str_extract(variants, "[a-z]$")
    suffixes <- suffixes[!is.na(suffixes)]
    
    n_suffixes <- length(suffixes)
    if (n_suffixes == 0) {
      # Base exists without suffixes, next is 'b'
      return("b")
    }
    
    # Suggest next letter after highest existing suffix
    if (n_suffixes > 0) {
      highest_suffix <- sort(suffixes, decreasing = TRUE)[1]
      highest_code <- as.numeric(charToRaw(highest_suffix))
      next_suffix <- rawToChar(as.raw(highest_code + 1))
      return(next_suffix)
    }
    
    return("b")
  }
  

  all_db_variants <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(variant), variant != "") %>%
  pull(variant) %>%
  unique()
  
  variant_suggestions <- summary_tbl %>%
    select(seqName, clade, blast_genotype, blast_variant, blast_mismatch, sseqid) %>%
    mutate(
      variant_suggestion = case_when(
        !is.na(blast_mismatch) & blast_mismatch == 0 & !is.na(blast_variant) ~ blast_variant,
        !is.na(blast_mismatch) & blast_mismatch == 1 & !is.na(blast_variant) ~ {
          suggested_suffix <- suggest_suffix(blast_variant, all_db_variants)
          paste0(blast_variant, suggested_suffix, " (1 SNP diff)")
        },
        !is.na(blast_mismatch) & blast_mismatch == 2 & !is.na(blast_variant) ~ {
          suggested_suffix <- suggest_suffix(blast_variant, all_db_variants)
          paste0(blast_variant, suggested_suffix, " (2 SNP diff)")
        },
        is.na(blast_variant) ~ "No BLAST hit â€” needs manual assignment",
        TRUE ~ "Review: >2 SNP difference from best hit"
      ),
      notes = case_when(
        !is.na(blast_mismatch) & blast_mismatch == 0 ~ "Identical to database sequence",
        !is.na(blast_mismatch) & blast_mismatch <= 2 ~ paste("Close to", sseqid),
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      Sequence = seqName,
      Genotype = clade,
      `BLAST hit` = sseqid,
      `SNPs` = blast_mismatch,
      `Hit variant` = blast_variant,
      `Suggested variant` = variant_suggestion,
      Notes = notes
    )
  
  cat(variant_suggestions %>%
        kbl(escape = FALSE) %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE) %>%
        as.character())
} else {
  cat("*No sequences for variant naming.*\n\n")
}
```

**Variant naming protocol:**
- **Identical to database (0 SNPs):** Assign same variant as BLAST hit
- **1-2 SNPs from database sequence:** Check database for existing b/c suffixes, suggest next available (e.g., b if none exist, c if b exists)
- **>2 SNPs:** Manual review required; may warrant new variant number

# 4. Outbreak detection

```{r outbreak-detection, results='asis'}

# Load BLAST results to identify which variants batch sequences match
# Variants come from database variant assignments
blast_path <- file.path(params$out_base, "blast_results.tsv")
blast_data <- if (file.exists(blast_path)) {
  read_tsv(
    blast_path,
    col_names = c("qseqid", "sseqid", "pident", "length", "mismatch", "gapopen",
                  "qstart", "qend", "sstart", "send", "evalue", "bitscore"),
    col_types = "ccddddiiiidd",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
} else {
  tibble(
    qseqid = character(),
    sseqid = character(),
    pident = numeric(),
    length = numeric(),
    mismatch = numeric(),
    gapopen = numeric(),
    qstart = integer(),
    qend = integer(),
    sstart = integer(),
    send = integer(),
    evalue = numeric(),
    bitscore = numeric()
  )
}

# Define robust ID normalization
norm_id <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(x, to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- tolower(x)
  gsub("[-_]", "", x, perl = TRUE)
}

# Extract base variant (remove trailing a/b/c/d suffixes)
extract_base_variant <- function(variant) {

  variant <- iconv(
    as.character(variant),
    from = "",
    to = "UTF-8",
    sub = ""
  )

  variant[variant == ""] <- NA_character_

  stringr::str_remove(variant, "[a-z]$")
}


# Identify batch variants:
# For each batch sequence, get best BLAST hit (first row, sorted by score)
# Then look up the variant from database metadata
# Group by BASE variant (removing sub-variant suffixes like a/b/c)
batch_variants <- blast_data %>%
  arrange(
    qseqid,
    mismatch,
    desc(bitscore)
  ) %>%
  group_by(qseqid) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    qseqid,
    sseqid
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sseqid_norm = norm_id(sseqid)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(variant),
        variant != ""
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        id_norm = norm_id(id)
      ) %>%
      select(
        id_norm,
        variant
      ),
    by = c("sseqid_norm" = "id_norm")
  ) %>%
  select(
    seqName = qseqid,
    variant
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(variant)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    base_variant = extract_base_variant(variant)
  )


# Group by base variant
batch_variant_summary <- batch_variants %>%
  group_by(base_variant) %>%
  summarise(
    n_batch = n(),
    batch_seqs = paste(
      sort(unique(seqName)),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Add database counts for context
if (nrow(meta) > 0 && "variant" %in% names(meta)) {
  
  db_variant_summary <- meta %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(variant),
      variant != ""
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      base_variant = extract_base_variant(variant)
    ) %>%
    group_by(base_variant) %>%
    summarise(
      n_db = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  outbreak_candidates <- batch_variant_summary %>%
    left_join(
      db_variant_summary,
      by = "base_variant"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n_db = replace_na(n_db, 0L),
      n_total = n_batch + n_db
    ) %>%
    select(
      base_variant,
      n_batch,
      n_db,
      n_total,
      batch_seqs
    )
} else {
  outbreak_candidates <- batch_variant_summary %>%
    mutate(
      n_db = 0L,
      n_total = n_batch
    ) %>%
    select(
      base_variant,
      n_batch,
      n_db,
      n_total,
      batch_seqs
    )
}

if (nrow(outbreak_candidates) == 0) {
  cat("*No variants detected in batch.*\n\n")
} else {
  # Table shows variants with >=2 total sequences; trees require >=3 (built in build_outbreak_trees.R)
  outbreak_candidates_table <- outbreak_candidates %>%
    filter(n_total >= 2)
  outbreak_candidates_display <- outbreak_candidates %>%
    filter(n_total >= 3)
  
  if (nrow(outbreak_candidates_table) == 0) {
    cat("*No variants with â‰¥2 total sequences detected in batch.*\n\n")
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("**Variants in batch:** %d variant group(s) with â‰¥2 total sequences\n\n", nrow(outbreak_candidates_table)))
    
    # Summary table 
    cat("**Variant overview (â‰¥2 sequences):**\n\n")
    outbreak_display <- outbreak_candidates_table %>%
      select(
        `Variant` = base_variant,
        `Batch (n)` = n_batch,
        `Database (n)` = n_db,
        `Total` = n_total
      )
    
    cat(outbreak_display %>%
          kbl() %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE) %>%
        as.character())
    cat("\n\n")
  }
  
  # Create tabset structure for outbreak trees (display pre-generated PNG images)
  # NOTE: {.tabset} must be attached to an actual Markdown header, not bold text,
  # and tab headers must be exactly one level deeper for the tabset to activate.
  cat("## Phylogenetic trees by variant {.tabset}\n\n")
  
  # Check if outbreak_trees directory exists with PNG files
  outbreak_trees_dir <- file.path(params$out_base, "outbreak_trees")
  
  if (dir.exists(outbreak_trees_dir)) {
    png_files <- list.files(outbreak_trees_dir, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
    png_files <- sort(png_files)  # Sort alphabetically
    
    if (length(png_files) > 0) {
      # Create tabs for each PNG file (only variants with >=3 sequences)
      for (png_path in png_files) {
        variant_name <- sub("\\.png$", "", basename(png_path))
        
        # Get batch and DB sequence counts for this variant (from filtered candidates)
        variant_row <- outbreak_candidates_display %>%
          filter(base_variant == variant_name)
        
        # Skip if not in display list (should have >=3 sequences)
        if (nrow(variant_row) == 0) next
        
        n_batch_seqs <- variant_row$n_batch[1]
        n_db_seqs <- variant_row$n_db[1]
        
        # Create tab header
        cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", variant_name))
        cat(sprintf("**Batch samples:** %d | **Database samples:** %d | **Total:** %d\n\n",
                    n_batch_seqs, n_db_seqs, n_batch_seqs + n_db_seqs))
        
        # Embed pre-generated PNG image
        .embed_tree(
  png_path,
  alt = paste(
    "Outbreak phylogenetic tree for variant",
    variant_name
  )
)
        cat("\n\n")
        
        # Show database sequences with this variant
db_seqs_for_variant <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(variant), variant != "") %>%
  mutate(
    base_var = extract_base_variant(variant)
  ) %>%
  filter(base_var == variant_name) %>%
  select(
    id,
    variant,
    genotype,
    any_of("date")
  )

if (nrow(db_seqs_for_variant) > 0) {
  cat("**Database sequences with this variant:**\n\n")

  db_display <- db_seqs_for_variant %>%
    rename(
      ID = id,
      Variant = variant,
      Genotype = genotype
    )

  if ("date" %in% names(db_display)) {
    db_display <- db_display %>%
      rename(Date = date)
  }

  cat(
    db_display %>%
      kbl() %>%
      kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "hover",
          "condensed"
        ),
        full_width = TRUE
      ) %>%
      as.character()
  )

  cat("\n\n")
} # end database sequences display

      } # end for each png_file (outbreak trees)
    } else {
      cat("*Outbreak tree images were not generated. Run:*\n\n")
      cat("```bash\n")
      cat(sprintf("Rscript scripts/build_outbreak_trees.R '%s' '%s' '%s'\n",
                  params$out_base, params$dataset_date, params$dataset_dir))
      cat("```\n\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("*Outbreak tree images not found. Run the outbreak trees generation step:*\n\n")
    cat("```bash\n")
    cat(sprintf("Rscript scripts/build_outbreak_trees.R '%s' '%s' '%s'\n",
                params$out_base, params$dataset_date, params$dataset_dir))
    cat("```\n\n")
  } # end outbreak_trees_dir check
} # end outbreak detection

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(pheatmap)

# â”€â”€ Shared setup â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
ref_meta <- meta %>%
  select(id, genotype, variant) %>%
  mutate(
    id_norm = norm_id(id),
    genotype = str_to_upper(genotype),
    variant = if_else(
      is.na(variant) | variant == "",

      variant
    )

query_ids <- summary_tbl$seqName
called    <- c("a", "c", "g", "t")

# Normalize query IDs to match tree directory names (first token only, trimmed)
query_ids_normalized <- word(query_ids, 1)

.is_called <- function(x) {
  x %in% called
}

.consensus_base <- function(col) {
  vals <- col[.is_called(col)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tab <- sort(table(vals), decreasing = TRUE)
  names(tab)[1]
}

.col_entropy <- function(col) {
  vals <- col[.is_called(col)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  p <- as.numeric(table(vals)) / length(vals)
  -sum(p * log2(p))
}

.roll_mean <- function(x, k = 15) {
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) return(numeric(0))
  k <- max(1L, as.integer(k))
  h <- floor(k / 2)
  sapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    lo <- max(1L, i - h)
    hi <- min(n, i + h)
    mean(x[lo:hi], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
}

.rescale01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(rng)) || diff(rng) == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - rng[1]) / diff(rng)
}

.pick_zoom_windows <- function(score, n_windows = 5, width = 35) {
  if (length(score) == 0 || all(!is.finite(score))) {
    return(tibble(start = integer(), end = integer(), center = integer(), score = double()))
  }
  width <- max(5L, as.integer(width))
  half  <- floor(width / 2)
  ord   <- order(score, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
  chosen <- integer()
  for (idx in ord) {
    if (length(chosen) >= n_windows) break
    if (length(chosen) == 0 || all(abs(idx - chosen) > width)) {
      chosen <- c(chosen, idx)
    }
  }
  if (length(chosen) == 0) {
    return(tibble(start = integer(), end = integer(), center = integer(), score = double()))
  }
  tibble(
    center = chosen,
    start  = pmax(1L, chosen - half),
    end    = pmin(length(score), chosen + half),
    score  = score[chosen]
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(score))
}

treefile_exists <- sapply(query_ids_normalized, function(id) file.exists(file.path(trees_dir, id, "tree.treefile")))
aln_exists <- sapply(query_ids_normalized, function(id) {
  # Prefer BLAST-only alignment if available, otherwise fall back to full alignment
  blast_only <- file.exists(file.path(trees_dir, id, "aligned_trimmed_blast_only.fa"))
  full_aln <- file.exists(file.path(trees_dir, id, paste0(id, ".aligned_trimmed.fasta")))
  blast_only || full_aln
})

if (length(query_ids) == 0) {
  cat("## Status\n\n")
  cat("*No sequences available in summary table for per-sequence details.*\n\n")
} else if (!any(treefile_exists) && !any(aln_exists)) {
  cat("## Status\n\n")
  cat("Per-sequence tree outputs are not present for this batch, so detailed tree/alignment panels are skipped.\n\n")

  status_tbl <- tibble(
    Sequence = query_ids,
    `Tree file` = if_else(treefile_exists, "Found", "Missing"),
    `Tree alignment` = if_else(aln_exists, "Found", "Missing")
  )

  cat(kbl(status_tbl, caption = "Per-sequence tree artifacts") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                      full_width = TRUE) %>%
        as.character())
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("Run this first (from project root) to populate section 6:\n\n")
  cat("```bash\n")
  cat(sprintf("bash scripts/build_per_seq_trees.sh %s %s\n", params$batch_dir, params$dataset_date))
  cat("```\n\n")
  cat("Short-region alignment inspection is still available in section 0 under **Junction alignment (focused viewer)**.\n\n")
} else { # tree or alignment files are available
for (i in seq_along(query_ids)) {
  query_id <- query_ids[i]
  query_id_norm <- query_ids_normalized[i]
  cat(paste0("\n## ", query_id, "\n\n"))

  tree_dir <- file.path(trees_dir, query_id_norm)
  # Prefer BLAST-only alignment if available, otherwise fall back to full alignment
  aln_file <- if (file.exists(file.path(tree_dir, "aligned_trimmed_blast_only.fa"))) {
    file.path(tree_dir, "aligned_trimmed_blast_only.fa")
  } else {
    file.path(tree_dir, paste0(query_id_norm, ".aligned_trimmed.fasta"))
  }
  treefile <- file.path(tree_dir, "tree.treefile")
  tr <- NULL

  # Read alignment once â€” used by both SNP and MSA sections
  seqs_raw <- if (file.exists(aln_file)) {
    tryCatch(ape::read.dna(aln_file, format = "fasta", as.character = TRUE),
             error = function(e) NULL)
  } else NULL
  # The saved .aligned.fasta/.aligned_trimmed.fasta files mark the query header
  # with a trailing " [QUERY]" for readability â€” strip it back off so all the
  # exact-match comparisons against query_id below keep working unchanged.
  if (!is.null(seqs_raw)) {
    rownames(seqs_raw) <- sub(" \\[QUERY\\]$", "", rownames(seqs_raw))
  }
  # Defensive: duplicate FASTA headers (e.g. from an older alignment generated
  # before the batch FASTA duplicate-header guard) would otherwise crash
  # data.frame() further down with "duplicate row.names". Keep the first
  # occurrence's name intact (so query_id matching still works) and suffix
  # any repeats instead of failing the whole report.
  if (!is.null(seqs_raw) && anyDuplicated(rownames(seqs_raw)) > 0) {
    dup_ids <- unique(rownames(seqs_raw)[duplicated(rownames(seqs_raw))])
    cat(sprintf("*Warning: duplicate sequence header(s) in alignment (%s) â€” extra copies were renamed for display.*\n\n",
                paste(dup_ids, collapse = ", ")))
    rownames(seqs_raw) <- make.unique(rownames(seqs_raw))
  }

  # â”€â”€ 1. Phylogenetic tree â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  cat("### Phylogenetic tree\n\n")
  if (!file.exists(treefile)) {
    cat("*Tree not available â€” run `build_per_seq_trees.sh` first.*\n\n")
  } else {
    tr <- tryCatch(read.tree(treefile), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(tr)) {
      cat("*Could not parse tree.*\n\n")
    } else {
      tr <- phangorn::midpoint(tr)

      # If one/few branches are extreme outliers, branch-length plotting can
      # visually collapse the rest of the tree. In that case, switch to a
      # topology-only view for readability.
      # The ratio alone is misleading for tight clusters (near-zero median
      # branch length inflates the ratio even when the longest branch is
      # small in absolute terms), so also require a genuinely large absolute
      # branch length before falling back to the cladogram view.
      edge_len <- tr$edge.length
      edge_len <- edge_len[is.finite(edge_len) & !is.na(edge_len) & edge_len > 0]
      long_branch_ratio <- if (length(edge_len) > 0) {
        max(edge_len) / max(median(edge_len), 1e-6)
      } else {
        1
      }
      max_edge_len <- if (length(edge_len) > 0) max(edge_len) else 0
      # Disabled for now â€” always render as a phylogram with real branch lengths.
      # use_cladogram_view <- long_branch_ratio > 25 && max_edge_len > 0.05
      use_cladogram_view <- FALSE

tip_info <- tibble(id = tr$tip.label) %>%
  left_join(
    ref_meta %>%
      select(id_norm, genotype, variant),
    by = c("id" = "id_norm")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    community_meta,
    by = "id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype = coalesce(
      genotype,
      community_clade
    ),

    is_query = id == query_id,

    tip_label = case_when(
      !is.na(genotype) &
        !is.na(variant) ~
        paste0(
          id, "  [", genotype,
          "  ", variant, "]"
        ),

      !is.na(genotype) ~
        paste0(id, "  [", genotype, "]"),

      !is.na(variant) ~
        paste0(id, "  [", variant, "]"),

      !is.na(community_clade) ~
        paste0(id, "  [", community_clade, "]"),

      TRUE ~ id
    ),

    tip_color = case_when(
      is_query ~ "Query",
      !is.na(variant) & variant != "" ~ variant,
      !is.na(genotype) & genotype != "NA" ~ genotype,
      !is.na(community_clade) ~ community_clade,
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

      all_colors <- unique(tip_info$tip_color)
      ref_colors <- setdiff(all_colors, "Query")
      pal <- setNames(
        c("#d62728", scales::hue_pal()(length(ref_colors))),
        c("Query", ref_colors)
      )

      p <- if (use_cladogram_view) {
        ggtree(
          tr,
          layout = "fan",
          open.angle = 15,
          branch.length = "none"
        ) %<+% tip_info +
          geom_tippoint(aes(color = tip_color), size = 3) +
          geom_tiplab(aes(label = tip_label), size = 2.6, align = TRUE, linetype = NA, offset = 0.15) +
          scale_color_manual(values = pal, name = "Variant") +
          guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
          theme_void() +
          theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
      } else {
        ggtree(
          tr,
          layout = "rectangular",
          branch.length = "branch.length"
        ) %<+% tip_info +
          geom_tippoint(aes(color = tip_color), size = 3) +
          geom_tiplab(aes(label = tip_label), size = 2.8, hjust = -0.05) +
          scale_color_manual(values = pal, name = "Variant") +
          guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
          theme_tree2() +
          theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)) +
          hexpand(.6)
      }

      bs_df <- p$data %>%
        filter(!isTip, !is.na(label)) %>%
        mutate(bs_val = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(label))) %>%
        filter(!is.na(bs_val), bs_val >= 50)
      if (nrow(bs_df) > 0) {
        p <- p + geom_text(data = bs_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = round(bs_val)),
                           inherit.aes = FALSE,
                           size = 2.5, hjust = 1.15, vjust = -0.4, color = "grey35")
      }

      # Persist to output/trees/<seqName>/tree.png (not a tempfile) so it survives after report generation
      tree_png_path <- file.path(tree_dir, "tree.png")
      ggsave(tree_png_path, plot = p, width = 18, height = 9, dpi = 150)

      if (!file.exists(tree_png_path)) {
        stop(
          "Per-sequence tree figure was not created: ",
          tree_png_path
        )
      }

      .embed_tree(
        tree_png_path,
        alt = paste("Phylogenetic tree for", query_id)
      )

      if (use_cladogram_view) {
        cat("*Display note:* Large branch-length outliers detected. Tree is shown as a topology-only cladogram for readability; branch lengths are still preserved in `tree.treefile`.\n\n")
      }
      cat("\n")

meta_tbl <- tip_info %>%
  arrange(desc(is_query), tip_color, id) %>%
  select(
    ID = id,
    Variant = variant,
    Genotype = genotype
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(Variant, Genotype),
      ~ if_else(
        is.na(.x) | .x %in% c("NA", ""),
        "â€”",
        as.character(.x)
      )
    )
  )

      cat(kbl(meta_tbl, caption = paste("Sequences in tree:", query_id)) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                          full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11) %>%
            as.character())
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }

  # â”€â”€ 2. SNP distance heatmap â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  cat("### SNP distance heatmap\n\n")
  
  # Use alignment content as-is.
  # When aligned_trimmed_blast_only.fa exists, this is already query + selected BLAST neighbors.
  # For older batches without BLAST-only alignment we keep existing alignment content.
  seqs_heatmap <- if (!is.null(seqs_raw) && nrow(seqs_raw) > 0) {
    if (nrow(seqs_raw) >= 2) seqs_raw else NULL
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  if (is.null(seqs_heatmap) || nrow(seqs_heatmap) < 2) {
    cat("*Alignment not available or too few sequences.*\n\n")
  } else {
    n_tips  <- nrow(seqs_heatmap)
    ids     <- rownames(seqs_heatmap)
    snp_mat <- matrix(0L, n_tips, n_tips, dimnames = list(ids, ids))
    for (i in seq_len(n_tips - 1)) {
      for (j in (i + 1):n_tips) {
        s1 <- seqs_heatmap[i, ]; s2 <- seqs_heatmap[j, ]
        # Count mismatches on all non-gap aligned positions.
        # This keeps SNP distance closer to BLAST mismatch behavior.
        valid <- s1 != "-" & s2 != "-"
        d <- sum(s1[valid] != s2[valid])
        snp_mat[i, j] <- snp_mat[j, i] <- d
      }
    }

    ref_meta_hm <- if (
  nrow(meta) > 0 &&
  all(c("id", "variant") %in% names(meta))
) {
  meta %>%
    transmute(
      id = as.character(id),
      hm_variant = as.character(variant),
      hm_genotype = if ("genotype" %in% names(meta)) {
        as.character(genotype)
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    )
} else {
  tibble(
    id = character(),
    hm_variant = character(),
    hm_genotype = character()
  )
}


    lbl_tbl <- tibble(id = ids) %>%
      left_join(ref_meta_hm, by = "id") %>%
      left_join(community_meta, by = "id") %>%
      mutate(
        variant  = hm_variant,
        genotype = coalesce(harmonise_genotype(hm_genotype), community_clade),
        # Shorten long FASTA headers: extract accession + isolate/strain name
        # Handles both "isolate XXXX" and "strain: XXXX" formats
        # E.g., "KX151409.1 Hepatovirus A isolate h737 ..." â†’ "KX151409.1 (h737)"
        # E.g., "LC035017.1 Hepatitis A virus gene for polyprotein, partial cds, strain: 1404-20055-WakymC-4HA42" â†’ "LC035017.1 (1404-20055-WakymC-4HA42)"
        short_id = {
          accession <- str_extract(id, "^[^\\s]+")
          # Extract isolate/strain name: try "isolate" pattern, then "strain:" pattern
          isolate_m1 <- str_extract(id, "(?<= isolate )[^ ,]+")
          isolate_m2 <- str_extract(id, "(?<=strain: )[^ ,]+")
          isolate_part <- coalesce(isolate_m1, isolate_m2)
          
          if_else(!is.na(isolate_part),
                 paste0(accession, " (", isolate_part, ")"),
                 accession)
        },
        display = case_when(
  id == query_id ~
    paste0(short_id, "  \u2605"),

  !is.na(genotype) &
    !is.na(variant) ~
    paste0(
      short_id, "  [", genotype,
      "  ", variant, "]"
    ),

  !is.na(genotype) ~
    paste0(short_id, "  [", genotype, "]"),

  !is.na(variant) ~
    paste0(short_id, "  [", variant, "]"),

  TRUE ~ short_id
)
      )
    lbl_map <- setNames(lbl_tbl$display, lbl_tbl$id)
    rownames(snp_mat) <- lbl_map[rownames(snp_mat)]
    colnames(snp_mat) <- lbl_map[colnames(snp_mat)]

    query_lbl <- lbl_map[query_id]
    ann_row <- data.frame(
      Type = ifelse(rownames(snp_mat) == query_lbl, "Query", "Reference"),
      row.names = rownames(snp_mat)
    )
    ann_colors <- list(Type = c(Query = "#d62728", Reference = "#aec7e8"))

    # Adaptive sizing: base cell size on number of sequences
    # Ensures readable labels and numbers even with many sequences
    cell_size <- if (n_tips <= 10) 60 else if (n_tips <= 20) 45 else 30
    fontsize_main <- if (n_tips <= 10) 15 else if (n_tips <= 20) 14 else 13
    fontsize_num <- if (n_tips <= 10) 12 else if (n_tips <= 20) 11 else 10
    fontsize_row <- if (n_tips <= 15) 13 else 11
    
    # Calculate figure size with minimum/maximum constraints
    px <- min(18, max(10, n_tips * (cell_size / 35)))
    
    # Continuous blue palette for SNP distances
color_func <- colorRampPalette(
  c(
    "#f7fbff",
    "#deebf7",
    "#9ecae1",
    "#3182bd",
    "#08519c",
    "#08306b"
  )
)(100)

# Keep only finite values when determining the colour scale
finite_snp_values <- as.numeric(snp_mat)
finite_snp_values <- finite_snp_values[is.finite(finite_snp_values)]

if (length(finite_snp_values) == 0) {
  cat("*SNP matrix contains no finite values and cannot be plotted.*\n\n")
} else {
  snp_min <- min(finite_snp_values)
  snp_max <- max(finite_snp_values)
  constant_snp_matrix <- snp_min == snp_max

  if (constant_snp_matrix) {
    # pheatmap requires unique break values.
    # Add a small interval around the single observed value.
    heat_breaks <- seq(
      from = snp_min - 0.5,
      to = snp_max + 0.5,
      length.out = length(color_func) + 1
    )

    cluster_rows <- FALSE
    cluster_cols <- FALSE
    heat_treeheight_row <- 0
    heat_treeheight_col <- 0
  } else {
    heat_breaks <- seq(
      from = snp_min,
      to = snp_max,
      length.out = length(color_func) + 1
    )

    cluster_rows <- TRUE
    cluster_cols <- TRUE
    heat_treeheight_row <- 100
    heat_treeheight_col <- 100
  }

  # Defensive check: pheatmap/cut requires strictly unique breaks
  heat_breaks <- unique(heat_breaks)

  if (length(heat_breaks) < 2) {
    heat_breaks <- c(snp_min - 0.5, snp_max + 0.5)
  }

  safe_query_filename <- gsub(
  "[^A-Za-z0-9._-]",
  "_",
  query_id
)

heatmap_png <- file.path(
  report_figures_dir,
  paste0(safe_query_filename, "_snp_heatmap.png")
)

  .ph_obj <- pheatmap(
    snp_mat,
    color = color_func,
    breaks = heat_breaks,
    cluster_rows = cluster_rows,
    cluster_cols = cluster_cols,
    clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(snp_mat),
    clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(snp_mat),
    clustering_method = "average",
    display_numbers = TRUE,
    number_format = "%d",
    number_color = "black",
    fontsize = fontsize_main,
    fontsize_number = fontsize_num,
    fontsize_row = fontsize_row,
    annotation_row = ann_row,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    legend = !constant_snp_matrix,
    main = paste("Pairwise SNP distances â€”", query_id),
    treeheight_row = heat_treeheight_row,
    treeheight_col = heat_treeheight_col,
    border_color = "#cccccc",
    gaps_row = which(rownames(snp_mat) == query_lbl),
    gaps_col = which(colnames(snp_mat) == query_lbl),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  ggsave(
    heatmap_png,
    plot = .ph_obj$gtable,
    width = px,
    height = px,
    dpi = 150,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  if (!file.exists(heatmap_png)) {
  stop("SNP heatmap was not created: ", heatmap_png)
}

.embed_img(heatmap_png)

  if (constant_snp_matrix) {
    cat(
      sprintf(
        "*All pairwise SNP distances are %s. Clustering was disabled because the matrix is constant.*\n\n",
        snp_min
      )
    )
  }
}
    
    # Save SNP distance matrix as TSV for external analysis
    snp_tsv <- file.path(out_dir, "snp_matrices", paste0(query_id, "_snp_distances.tsv"))
    dir.create(dirname(snp_tsv), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    
    # Convert matrix to data frame with sequence IDs in first column
    snp_df <- as.data.frame(snp_mat)
    snp_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(snp_df, var = "Sequence_1")
    names(snp_df)[-1] <- rownames(snp_mat)  # Ensure column names are sequence labels
    
    write_tsv(snp_df, snp_tsv)
    cat("[Download SNP distance matrix](snp_matrices/", query_id, "_snp_distances.tsv)\n\n", sep = "")
    
    cat("\n\n")
  } # end SNP heatmap display
} # end for each query
} # end tree/alignment availability check

```

n_blast_agree <- sum(summary_tbl$clade_agree_blast == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

```{r write-outputs, include=FALSE}
# â”€â”€ Prepare summary.tsv with expanded columns and new order â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

summary_tsv_output <- summary_tbl %>%

  # Add input sequence metrics
  left_join(
    input_seq_summary %>%
      select(
        seqName,
        input_length = length,
        ambiguous_count
      ),
    by = "seqName"
  ) %>%

  # Add LabWareID and SequenceID from samplesheet
  left_join(
    .ss_sample_info %>%
      select(
        Sample,
        LabWareID,
        SequenceID = SekvensID
      ),
    by = c("seqName" = "Sample")
  ) %>%

  # Add database variant count for the top BLAST hit
  left_join(
    .blast_variant_counts,
    by = "blast_variant"
  ) %>%

  # Add variants with similar BLAST distance
  left_join(
    .db_variant_summary$similar,
    by = c(
      "qseqid" = "qseqid",
      "sseqid" = "sseqid"
    )
  ) %>%

  # Ensure the column always exists, including when no similar variants exist
  mutate(
    similar_variants = coalesce(
      as.character(similar_variants),
      ""
    ),

    LabWareID = if_else(
      !is.na(LabWareID),
      as.character(LabWareID),
      word(seqName, 1)
    ),

    SequenceID = if_else(
      !is.na(SequenceID),
      as.character(SequenceID),
      word(seqName, 2)
    )
  ) %>%

  select(
    LabWareID,
    SequenceID,
    Genotype_NC = clade,
    Genotype_BLAST = blast_genotype,
    Clade_agree_blast = clade_agree_blast,
    BLAST_top_hit = sseqid,
    BLAST_variant = blast_variant,
    BLAST_SNPs = blast_mismatch,
    DB_variant_count = db_variant_count,
    Other_similar_BLAST_variant = similar_variants,
    Input_length = input_length,
    Ambiguous = ambiguous_count,
    BLAST_pident = blast_pident,
    BLAST_qcov = blast_qcovs,
    BLAST_bitscore = blast_bitscore,
    NC_qc_status = qc_status,
    NC_qc_score = qc_score,
    substitutions,
    aaSubstitutions,
    privateNucMuts_total,
    totalSubstitutions
  )

# Write summary TSV
write_tsv(summary_tsv_output, file.path(params$out_base, "summary.tsv"))

# NOTE: comparison.tsv was removed â€” summary.tsv now contains all comparison data
# (Genotype_NC, Genotype_BLAST, Clade_agree_blast, etc.)

```{r collect-figures-alignments, include=FALSE}
# â”€â”€ Collect per-sequence phylogenetic tree images â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
# Copy all tree.png files from output/trees/<seqName>/ to report_figures/
seq_tree_pngs <- list.files(
  trees_dir,
  pattern = "tree\\.png$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
if (length(seq_tree_pngs) > 0) {
  for (png_path in seq_tree_pngs) {
    seq_name <- basename(dirname(png_path))
    dest <- file.path(report_figures_dir, paste0(seq_name, "_tree.png"))
    file.copy(png_path, dest, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
}

# â”€â”€ Collect outbreak phylogenetic tree images â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
# Copy all .png files from output/outbreak_trees/ to report_figures/
outbreak_trees_dir <- file.path(params$out_base, "outbreak_trees")
if (dir.exists(outbreak_trees_dir)) {
  outbreak_pngs <- list.files(
    outbreak_trees_dir,
    pattern = "\\.png$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (length(outbreak_pngs) > 0) {
    for (png_path in outbreak_pngs) {
      file.copy(png_path, file.path(report_figures_dir, basename(png_path)), overwrite = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

# â”€â”€ Collect alignment FASTA files â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
# Create alignments folder and copy all .fasta files
alignments_dir <- file.path(params$out_base, "alignments")
dir.create(alignments_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# NextClade junction alignment
nextclade_aln <- file.path(out_dir, "lineages", "nextclade.aligned.fasta")
if (file.exists(nextclade_aln)) {
  file.copy(nextclade_aln, file.path(alignments_dir, "nextclade_junction.fasta"), overwrite = TRUE)
}

# Per-sequence alignments from trees
seq_alns <- list.files(
  trees_dir,
  pattern = "\\.(aligned_trimmed\\.fasta|fasta)$|aligned_trimmed_blast_only\\.fa$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
if (length(seq_alns) > 0) {
  for (aln_path in seq_alns) {
    seq_name <- basename(dirname(aln_path))
    fname <- basename(aln_path)
    # Convert .fa to .fasta
    fname <- sub("\\.fa$", ".fasta", fname)
    dest <- file.path(alignments_dir, paste0(seq_name, "_", fname))
    file.copy(aln_path, dest, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
}

# Batch alignment
batch_aln <- file.path(trees_dir, "batch", "batch.aligned.fasta")
if (file.exists(batch_aln)) {
  file.copy(batch_aln, file.path(alignments_dir, "batch_alignment.fasta"), overwrite = TRUE)
}

# Remove any duplicate batch_batch_alignment.fasta if it exists
batch_batch_duplicate <- file.path(alignments_dir, "batch_batch_alignment.fasta")
if (file.exists(batch_batch_duplicate)) {
  unlink(batch_batch_duplicate)
}

# Outbreak alignments
if (dir.exists(outbreak_trees_dir)) {
  outbreak_fastas <- list.files(
    outbreak_trees_dir,
    pattern = "\\.fasta$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (length(outbreak_fastas) > 0) {
    for (fasta_path in outbreak_fastas) {
      file.copy(fasta_path, file.path(alignments_dir, basename(fasta_path)), overwrite = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

# â"€â"€ Cleanup: Convert any remaining .fa files to .fasta â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€â"€
fa_files <- list.files(alignments_dir, pattern = "\\.fa$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(fa_files) > 0) {
  for (fa_path in fa_files) {
    fasta_path <- sub("\\.fa$", ".fasta", fa_path)
    file.rename(fa_path, fasta_path)
  }
}
